What are the densest materials the Materials Project has computed?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(density AS double) AS density_g_cm3 FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules
Which journals have published the most articles?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007

SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2025'

SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
In 2022, how did notices, proposed rules and final rules compare in number?
SELECT doc_type, count(*) AS documents FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE issue_date LIKE '"2022-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Texas cities have the most hazardous waste sites on EPA's list?
SELECT city_name, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities WHERE state_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in import duties did the United States collect on goods arriving in 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cal_dut_mo AS double)) AS duties FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl WHERE year = '2024'
Under which statutes are patent cases most often brought?
SELECT case_cause, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has national Medicaid drug spending changed each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE state = 'XX' AND try_cast(year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
How are hospitals filing fiscal 2023 cost reports owned: nonprofit, for-profit or government?

SELECT CASE WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('1', '2') THEN 'Nonprofit' WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') THEN 'For-profit' ELSE 'Government' END AS ownership, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly electricity demand on California's grid on March 18, 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.CISO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '20220318%'
Which organisations reported the most federal spending in their 2023 single audits?
SELECT auditee_name, try_cast(total_amount_expended AS double) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many U.S. patent applications have been published?
Which states have the most active Davis-Bacon wage determinations?
SELECT states, count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'dbra' AND is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of CPSC product recalls change from 2010 to 2023?
SELECT substr(recalldate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2023') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the highest unemployment rates in December 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many granted patents contributed reactions to the reaction set?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants
Which diseases have the most drugs approved or in clinical trials?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Have hub heights grown? Compare turbines built in 2010 with those built in 2020.
SELECT p_year, avg(try_cast(t_hh AS double)) AS avg_hub_height_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) IN ('2010', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which universities own the most U.S. patents?

SELECT disambig_assignee_organization AS university, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated WHERE upper(disambig_assignee_organization) LIKE '%UNIVERSITY%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do hospital charges compare with what Medicare pays for a joint replacement stay?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_submtd_cvrd_chrg AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_charge, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_medicare_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '470'
How are judges' recorded party affiliations split?

SELECT CASE political_party WHEN 'd' THEN 'Democratic' WHEN 'r' THEN 'Republican' WHEN 'i' THEN 'Independent' WHEN 'f' THEN 'Federalist' WHEN 'w' THEN 'Whig' ELSE political_party END AS party, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_political_affiliations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do pharmacies pay on average for one 20 mg atorvastatin tablet?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 4) AS cost_per_tablet FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'ATORVASTATIN 20 MG TAB%' AND substr(effective_date, 7, 4) = '2024'
Which companies reported the largest net losses for fiscal 2021?

SELECT s.name, min(n.value) AS net_income FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '4' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many Reactome reactions have a Rhea counterpart?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2reactome
Which papers are cited most often by other papers in PubMed?
SELECT ref_pmid, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_health.pubmed_references WHERE ref_pmid <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, how many days of extra patent term do patents get for USPTO delays?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which parent companies have the most affiliates registered as federal award recipients?
SELECT parent_legal_business_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE parent_legal_business_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many EPA and state inspections have facilities in Ohio had over the last five years?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fac_inspection_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state = 'OH'

SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS republican_members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE party = 'R' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%medicare%' ORDER BY date LIMIT 5
Which New York counties have the largest land area?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties WHERE usps = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many babies were born in Manhattan hospitals in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'

SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%' AND substr(start_date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10

SELECT l.disambig_city AS city, l.disambig_country AS country, count(DISTINCT a.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_location_disambiguated l ON l.location_id = a.location_id WHERE a.disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did private-sector employment in Manhattan change from the first quarter of 2019 to the first quarter of 2024?

SELECT year, month3_emplvl AS employed FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36061' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2024') AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY year

SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE funcstat = 'A' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.PRICE.%-ALL.A' AND length(series_id) = 19 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(injured AS integer)) AS injured FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'TESLA' AND modeltxt = 'MODEL 3'

SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.oral_arguments

SELECT c8 AS make, count(DISTINCT c2) AS bulletins FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_service_bulletins GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study

SELECT agency, count(*) AS forms FROM govblock_reference.forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Income by ZIP Code and County
SELECT sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS returns FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE zipcode = '10001' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%'

SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS million_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.SALES.US-ALL.A' AND period = '2023'

SELECT rptowner_title, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner WHERE rptowner_title <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT longname, sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_assistance_listings

SELECT count(*) AS payments FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2016' AND upper(purpose) LIKE '%POLL%'

What share of working residents of Cook County, Illinois, were 55 or older in 2021?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(ca03) / sum(c000), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'il' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '17031'

SELECT f.facility_name, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_facility AS f ON f.facility_id = e.facility_id AND f.year = e.year WHERE e.year = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE ARMY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'TX' AND naics_code LIKE '23%' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2023'
Which counties paid the highest average annual wage in 2023?

What share of judges in the biographical database are women?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN gender = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_courts.people_db_people WHERE gender IS NOT NULL AND gender <> ''

SELECT utility_name, try_cast(res_rate AS double) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE zip = '10001' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT fy, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE try_cast(fy AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT termination_reason, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(termination_reason, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(value AS double)) AS value FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer LIKE 'NVIDIA%'

SELECT institution_type, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_institutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS plant_applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE invention_type = 'PLT'

SELECT column11 AS state, count(*) AS organizations FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8871 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN p_np = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bbbp
Which kinds of measurement are most common among ChEMBL bioactivity results?
SELECT standard_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE standard_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many put options on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury fund appear in 13F filings?
SELECT count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer = 'ISHARES TR' AND titleofclass LIKE 'BARCLYS 20+%' AND putcall = 'Put'
Which conditions have the most approved treatments?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total of federal penalties assessed in EPA enforcement cases?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fed_penalty AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_penalties
What types of institution does OpenAlex track, and how many of each?
SELECT type, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many offshore wells were spudded in 2010?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE substr(replace(spud_date, '"', ''), 1, 4) = '2010'
Which materials carry the strongest magnetization per formula unit?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units AS double) AS magnetization FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many PubMed articles are linked to caffeine?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_pmid WHERE c0 = '2519'
What are New York's biggest counties by 2025 population estimate?

SELECT ctyname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' AND stname = 'New York' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much solar power did California's grid operator generate in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which companies sponsor the most connected political action committees?
SELECT connected_org_nm, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE connected_org_nm <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Zenodo physics and chemistry records were published each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT publication_year, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE try_cast(publication_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which cities' recipients take in the most sub-award money?

SELECT concat(sub_legal_entity_city_name, ', ', sub_legal_entity_state_code), sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE sub_legal_entity_city_name IS NOT NULL AND concat(sub_legal_entity_city_name, ', ', sub_legal_entity_state_code) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many home loans were made in New York State in 2012?
SELECT count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2012' AND state_code = '36' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which states have the most petroleum terminals?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_petroleum_terminals WHERE status = 'IN SERVICE' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds share caffeine's formula, C8H10N4O2?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 = 'C8H10N4O2'
Which states have the largest share of their area under water?
SELECT name, round(100 * try_cast(awater AS double) / (try_cast(aland AS double) + try_cast(awater AS double)), 1) AS pct_water FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_state ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a gallon of whole milk cost on average in December 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000709112' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which NIH institutes gave out the most grant money in fiscal year 2023?
SELECT ic_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much coal did power plants in Kentucky receive in 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE plant_state = 'KY' AND fuel_group = 'Coal' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020'
Which firms sponsor the pooled investment funds that benefit plans invest in most often?
SELECT dfe_p1_spons_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_d_part1 WHERE dfe_p1_spons_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the SMILES string for ibuprofen?
SELECT c1 AS smiles FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_smiles WHERE c0 = '3672'
Which retired power plants were the largest?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT plant_name, state, round(sum(mw)) AS retired_mw FROM (SELECT plant_code, plant_name, state, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
In which states do public housing households have the lowest average income?

SELECT substr(states, 4) AS state, round(avg(try_cast(hh_income AS double))) AS avg_household_income FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(hh_income AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
What is the total of final penalties assessed in hazardous waste enforcement actions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fmp_amount AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which U.S. cities had the most residents in 2025?
SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of registered committees lean Democratic, Republican or neither?
SELECT cmte_pty_affiliation, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the most Medicare outpatient hospital services in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average severity score of a designated primary care shortage area?
Bcd Hpsa Fct Det Producer Prices
SELECT avg(try_cast(hpsa_score AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.hrsa_bcd_hpsa_fct_det_pc WHERE hpsa_status = 'Designated'
Which Treasury securities set records for the largest amount offered at auction?
SELECT concat(security_term, ' ', security_type) AS security, try_cast(high_offer_amt AS double) AS record_offer FROM govblock_treasury.record_setting_auction ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Did groceries or restaurant meals go up more in price in 2023?

SELECT CASE series_id WHEN 'CUUR0000SAF11' THEN 'food at home' ELSE 'food away from home' END AS item, year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id IN ('CUUR0000SAF11', 'CUUR0000SEFV') AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2022', '2023') ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10
What are the most common root causes of medical device recalls?
SELECT root_cause_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE root_cause_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median home value in Westchester County, New York?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36119' AND variable = 'B25077_E001'
